method.timing: Prepared SQL execution and JS row materialization; separate full public API validation for five slowest pages. Warm cache, no OS cache reset.
method.statistics: Product constructor optimize only; no forced ANALYZE.
method.scope: Supplement: request detail SQL without costs (provider/model; period/tokens/model sorts).
method.synthetic: Existing deterministic SQL fixture: 10 requests/session, 20 projects, 90-day spread; add cost, capability and manifest rows. Not a parsing benchmark.

SELECT
        *,
        (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AS has_recorded_usage
      FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      p.project_name,
      s.session_name
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      EXISTS(
        SELECT 1
        FROM turn_model_usage m
        WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> ''
      ) AS has_model
    FROM turn_summary t
  ) t
    JOIN projects p ON p.project_key = t.project_key
    JOIN sessions s ON s.provider = t.provider AND s.session_id = t.session_id
  ) AS turn_summary
      WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND id > ?
      ORDER BY started_at_ms IS NULL, started_at_ms IS NULL, started_at_ms DESC, provider, id
      LIMIT ?
      OFFSET ?

parts.sql:
SELECT
        *,
        (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AS has_recorded_usage
      FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      p.project_name,
      s.session_name
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.id,
      t.provider,
      t.project_key,
      t.session_id,
      t.root_turn_id,
      t.request_title,
      coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
      t.started_at_ms,
      t.completed_at_ms,
      t.duration_ms,
      t.duration_quality,
      t.status,
      t.quality_flags,
      t.diagnostic_file_id,
      t.diagnostic_offset,
      t.last_error,
      t.updated_at,
      CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = ''
    AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0
  THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
      
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens
  END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens
  END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
    
  ) t
    JOIN projects p ON p.project_key = t.project_key
    JOIN sessions s ON s.provider = t.provider AND s.session_id = t.session_id
  ) AS turn_summary
      WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND id > ?
      ORDER BY (started_at_ms IS NULL OR coalesce(model, '') = ''), started_at_ms IS NULL, coalesce(model, '') = '', started_at_ms IS NULL, started_at_ms DESC, provider, model, id
      LIMIT ?
      OFFSET ?
plan: SEARCH t USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid>?)
SEARCH m USING PRIMARY KEY (turn_id=?) LEFT-JOIN
SEARCH s USING PRIMARY KEY (provider=? AND session_id=?)
SEARCH p USING PRIMARY KEY (project_key=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
